_meta._note: CXRMate-2 (CSIRO AEHRC, arXiv 2604.18967v2 May 2026): SOTA chest X-ray radiology report generation (RRG) via GRPO RL + structured multimodal temporal embeddings; RAD-DINO visual encoder; 3B, apache-2.0. NEW model. Ingested Table 2 MIMIC-CXR (findings, n=1624) across 9 RRG metrics for CXRMate-2 + the 4 baselines already in the DB (MAIRA-2, MedGemma-4B, MedGemma-1.5-4B, MedVersa). These are RRG-specific research metrics (GREEN/RadGraph-XL/RaTEScore/CheXbert-F1/CXR-BERT/RadEval-BERTScore/BERTScore/BLEU-4/ROUGE-L) measured under one uniform protocol by the paper -> leaderboard-style, so baselines included (distinct from skipping a competitor's own-card standard benchmarks). Baselines NOT in DB (EMNLI, CXRMate, CXRMate-RRG24, CXRMate-ED, Libra, MLRG, PriorRG, DeepMedix-R1) skipped (no baseline-only stubs). Secondary datasets (CheXpert Plus n=62, ReXgradient n=10000) not ingested to avoid bench proliferation; CXRMate-2 headline there: CheXpert Plus GREEN 32.7 / RadGraph-XL 30.4, ReXgradient GREEN 58.1 / RadGraph-XL 41.7. Blinded radiologist eval: generated reports acceptable in 45% of ratings across 120 studies (qualitative, not ingested).

benchmarks.name: RaTEScore (MIMIC-CXR RRG)
benchmarks.description: RaTEScore — entity-level semantic alignment for radiology reports (Zhao et al. 2024), MIMIC-CXR test n=1624. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: GREEN (MIMIC-CXR RRG)
benchmarks.description: GREEN — LLM-based clinical error assessment for CXR report generation (Ostmeier et al. 2024), MIMIC-CXR n=1624. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: RadEval BERTScore (MIMIC-CXR RRG)
benchmarks.description: RadEval BERTScore — radiology-report semantic similarity (Xu et al. 2025), MIMIC-CXR n=1624. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: RadGraph-XL F1 (MIMIC-CXR RRG)
benchmarks.description: RadGraph-XL — graph-level factual correctness of generated CXR reports, MIMIC-CXR n=1624. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: CheXbert macro-F1 (MIMIC-CXR RRG)
benchmarks.description: CheXbert macro-averaged F1 over 14 findings between generated and radiologist reports (Smit et al. 2020), MIMIC-CXR n=1624. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: CXR-BERT (MIMIC-CXR RRG)
benchmarks.description: CXR-BERT radiology-report semantic similarity (Boecking et al. 2022), MIMIC-CXR n=1624. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: BERTScore (MIMIC-CXR RRG)
benchmarks.description: General-domain BERTScore (Zhang et al. 2019) between generated and radiologist findings, MIMIC-CXR n=1624. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: BLEU-4 (MIMIC-CXR RRG)
benchmarks.description: BLEU-4 lexical overlap for CXR report generation, MIMIC-CXR n=1624. Higher is better.

benchmarks.name: ROUGE-L (MIMIC-CXR RRG)
benchmarks.description: ROUGE-L lexical overlap for CXR report generation, MIMIC-CXR n=1624. Higher is better.
